**Specialpsykolog** (specialist psychologist) refers to a specialized professional group within the Danish psychiatric healthcare system. In the context of the national ADHD quality reports, specialist psychologists represent an alternative professional group to [[speciallaeger|speciallæger]] (specialist doctors), playing an increasingly critical role in addressing systemic challenges such as rising patient numbers and a shortage of medical specialists [^src2].

Historically, the involvement of specialist psychologists in formal diagnostic processes has varied by region. According to the 2023 ADHD database quality report, some regions conducted diagnostic conferences with a specialist psychologist, though this was not yet the majority practice [^src1]. The broader institutional narrative highlights an ongoing tension and necessary redistribution of interdisciplinary competencies between specialist doctors and specialist psychologists to standardize assessment pathways [^src1].

By 2024, the role of the specialist psychologist became a central focus for [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] (the steering group). Legislative changes formally opened the possibility for specialist psychologists to make psychiatric diagnoses [^src2]. This shift in legal competence made it necessary to reassess and reformulate national quality indicators, particularly [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]], to properly integrate the psychologists' competencies into diagnostic conferences [^src2]. Consequently, the steering group prioritized this indicator for the coming year to adapt to the changing legislative and clinical landscape [^src2].

- Page 26: "Nogle regioner har diagnostiske konferencer med specialpsykolog, men det er ikke flertallet af konferencer." [^src1]
